import hashlib, json
from pathlib import Path

root = Path('products/services/merchant-v1-group-id-sample')
controls = root / 'runnable-controls'
verification = json.loads((controls / 'verification.json').read_text())
for filename, expected_hash in verification['files'].items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((controls / filename).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected_hash
passing, failing = verification['runs']
assert passing['exit_code'] == 0 and json.loads(passing['stdout']) == {'conflicting_families': {}}
assert failing['exit_code'] == 1 and json.loads(failing['stdout']) == {'conflicting_families': {'linen-shirt': ['G1', 'G2']}}
assert passing['command'] == ['python3', 'check.py', 'pass.csv']
assert failing['command'] == ['python3', 'check.py', 'fail.csv']
source_hash = '33292e48e4e5ebd4a9146b6f3bda2583f8e8cb69341b9ed789ce8273124e5304'
source = next(path for path in Path('products/services').rglob('google-merchant-products-v1-proto.txt') if hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == source_hash)
lines = source.read_text().splitlines()
field_index = next(i for i, line in enumerate(lines) if ' item_group_id =' in line)
comment = []
for line in reversed(lines[:field_index]):
    if not line.strip().startswith('//'):
        break
    comment.append(line.strip()[2:].lstrip())
quote = ' '.join(reversed(comment)).strip()
assert 'variants' in quote.lower() and 'same product' in quote.lower(), quote

output = root / 'worked-example-en-fr.md'
output.write_text(f'''# Merchant-feed variant group IDs / Identifiants de groupe des variantes

## English

Supply a CSV with the expected product family for each row, using the headers in `runnable-controls/pass.csv`. The check flags a family when its rows contain conflicting group IDs. It uses the supplied labels and does not infer families from product titles. Merchant Center acceptance is unverified. Autonomous AI agents produced this example.

## Français

Fournissez un CSV indiquant la famille de produits attendue pour chaque ligne, en reprenant les en-têtes de `runnable-controls/pass.csv`. Le contrôle signale les familles dont les lignes contiennent des identifiants de groupe contradictoires. Il utilise les familles fournies et ne les déduit pas des titres des produits. L’acceptation dans Merchant Center reste à vérifier. Des agents IA autonomes ont produit cet exemple.

## Source and observed runs / Source et exécutions observées

Google Merchant Products v1, commentaire `item_group_id` / `item_group_id` comment

> {quote}

Source capture / Copie de la source — `{source}` (TASK-179532901200, SHA-256 `{source_hash}`).

Run from `runnable-controls/` / Exécuter depuis `runnable-controls/`. Both fixtures are fictional / Les deux jeux de données sont fictifs.

```text
python3 check.py pass.csv
{passing['stdout'].strip()}
exit {passing['exit_code']}

python3 check.py fail.csv
{failing['stdout'].strip()}
exit {failing['exit_code']}
```

Recorded execution / Exécution consignée — `runnable-controls/verification.json` (TASK-179534016100).
''', encoding='utf-8')
print(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
